review.title: Wink Wins Rounds
review.headline: Two silent Winks sank Farm before Blair's banked lead survived round three.
review.summary: In round 1 the Mouser Ellis winked the Owl, Blair, who was the only checkable witness. Ellis then helped push the vote onto Farm's Finley. In round 2 Blair, now the Mouser, winked Drew, the real Hawk who had exposed Ellis, and threw at Alex, who took the vote. Meowfia won both rounds, and Blair banked 14 points. In round 3 Blair was Farm and Ellis was the lone Mouser. Ellis winked Blair but was still eggsecuted, and Blair won the game with 26.

rounds.recap: Ellis winked Blair (Owl) early. Drew, Casey and Ellis pushed Finley because his Kookaburra claim could not be checked. Finley was eggsecuted as Farm, and Meowfia won.

Drew and Ellis both claimed Hawk, and Drew's +1 pointed at Ellis. Blair winked Drew mid-day. The table still leaned on Ellis, but Blair and Ellis threw at Alex, whose confused Kookaburra report made him look shaky. Alex was eggsecuted and Meowfia won.

Blair was Farm, and the table briefly suspected his Turkey claim because of a misread rule. Once that was cleared, Ellis's evasion made him the target. He winked Blair, but three CAWs ended the day and Ellis was eggsecuted. Farm won.

highlights.text: Ellis winks Blair on the first day. The only checkable Owl is silenced and a Farm player is eggsecuted.
Two players claim the single Hawk. Drew's gained egg proves he is right, then Blair winks him mid-argument.
Blair and Ellis, who did not know each other's alignment, throw at Alex. Alex takes the vote and Blair banks 14 points.
Blair's Turkey claim is attacked by a table that misread the rule. Drew's correction saves him.

confusions.what: Said a Turkey's nest should grow when visited. Turkey gives eggs to visitors.
Same Turkey misreading as Alex, in claiming Blair's nest should be up.
Same Turkey misreading, and said Alex's +2 contradicted the Falcon rule.
Misread his own Turkey rule at first. Said no eggs meant nobody visited him.
Joined the Blair push on the same Turkey misreading, then retracted.
Treated the confused Kookaburra report and the lost egg as evidence about others' visits.
Said Alex gains only 1 egg as Falcon, forgetting the egg from visiting the Turkey.

worked: The Mouser's Wink created real swings. It silenced the Owl in round 1 and the Hawk in round 2, and it made the third-round vote tense.
Nest-size changes gave checkable evidence. Drew's Hawk +1 and the Turkey/Falcon egg counts let players reason from the numbers.
Throw-count and consolation rules gave Blair and Ellis a real reason to throw at someone, and Farm's wrong throws still returned a card.
Role claims that contradict, like two Hawks, forced real arguments and clear deductions.
problems: The Mouser's Wink is too strong. It killed the key witness in both Meowfia rounds, and it is anonymous. Fix: reveal the Wink's existence, or limit it so it cannot be used before beat 3.
Round 1 had too little information. With no checkable witnesses, the vote was just a guess. Fix: give every Farm role a small guaranteed clue.
The Turkey text confused four players. Fix: reword it as 'visitors gain an egg, the Turkey does not'.
Score snowballing: Blair's 14-point win in round 2 made him nearly unreachable. Fix: cap the cards banked per round, or add catch-up.
Dead players still throwing cards and scoring is odd. Blair and Drew banked points after death, and the day's beat structure left Ellis with little to do after the vote.
